name: za-travel-allowance-tables
description: Year-keyed South African travel allowance and logbook rate tables, covering five years of assessment (2023 to 2027). Contains the SARS fixed cost table used for the deemed-cost method (fixed cost, fuel cost and maintenance cost by vehicle value band) and the prescribed reimbursive rate per kilometre for each year. Use for any South African travel claim, logbook computation, deemed cost lookup, reimbursive travel allowance, code 3701, 3702 or 3703 question, or company car and business travel deduction, for the current year or a prior year.
